messages:
Iris: Quick design sync 1: the Private setup wizard preflight is too noisy. Recommendation: show an outcome banner first (PASS / ACTION NEEDED) then let users dive into details.
Noah: Agreed. Banner should be focused on render (aria-live="assertive") for failures, and include one clear CTA: 'Fix' or 'Proceed (I understand risks)'.
Elena: For diagnostics keep logs collapsed. Per-check rows: icon, short title, status chip, and two inline actions: 'Run test' (async) and 'Help'. Expand details only on demand.
Iris: Copy suggestion: replace "Network error" with "Cannot reach instance: check firewall / route". Add a tiny 'Why this matters' link to KB.
ops-bot: preflight: 7 checks completed  1 blocking, 2 warnings.
Noah: For CIDR overlap, offer a 'Suggest non-conflicting range' helper that previews the change. Do NOT auto-apply; require explicit accept.
Elena: Accessibility notes: status chips must include text (Passed/Failed) not color alone. Use aria-describedby on helper buttons and trap focus in confirmation modals.
Iris: Mobile: only show banner + primary action; reveal diagnostics on tap. Also include a 'Download report' button (small JSON) for ops.
Noah: I'll prototype the banner-first flow and stub the aria attributes. Elena, can you provide the compact CLI snippets hidden behind 'Show command'?
Elena: Yup  will add examples like: ```nc -vz <ip> 8080``` collapsed by default.
Iris: Thanks team  will follow up with copy variants in Figma.
